title: Waiving Fees on Retail Installment Contracts
content:
**Once, while unpaid.** On Retail Installment Contracts, a fee can be waived only once and only while it remains unpaid.

**Assessed in error.** A fee shown to be assessed in error (outside the conditions of the policy that charges it) is waived in full with the waiver reason assessed in error, at any time and without limit.

**Bank error confirmed.** A returned-payment fee is waived with the waiver reason bank error confirmed when the borrower's bank confirms in writing that the return was its own error.

**Courtesy waiver.** Otherwise a representative may grant a courtesy waiver of one late charge or returned-payment fee of no more than the tier's largest courtesy-waiver amount, and only while the courtesy waivers already granted on the contract in the rolling 12 months are fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months. Agent-assisted payment fees, extension fees and reversed fee payments are never courtesy-waived.

**Full amount.** A waiver always removes the fee's full unpaid amount; partial waivers are not granted.

| Waiver reason | Fees it can cover | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| assessed in error | any fee charged outside the conditions of its policy | none; any time |
| bank error confirmed | returned-payment fee, with the bank's written confirmation | none stated |
| courtesy waiver | one late charge or returned-payment fee | fee no more than the tier's courtesy maximum; waivers in the rolling 12 months fewer than the tier's allowance |

The courtesy count is of waivers with the reason courtesy waiver dated in the rolling 12 months ending on the day measured.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A contract whose tier allows 1 courtesy waiver per 12 months, with one courtesy waiver granted five months ago, has none left; a late charge on it can still be waived as assessed in error if it was charged outside the late-charge conditions.
- An extension fee cannot be courtesy-waived at any tier.
